mapper.select: select c1.id, c1.bio_id, c1.user_id, c1.comment_body, c1.comment_status, c1.parent_id, c1.is_deleted, c1.gmt_create, c1.gmt_modified from biography.bio_comment c1 join biography.biography b on c1.bio_id = b.id where c1.bio_id = #{bioId} and c1.comment_status = 1 and c1.is_deleted = 0 and c1.parent_id is null and b.enable_comment = 0 and b.is_deleted = 0 and b.status = 1 and b.privacy_level = 0
